hero.description: For over 30 years, In Step has been the leader in Northern Virginia and the Washington DC area for individual, group and family therapy, specializing in social skills training, parent coaching, Interpersonal psychotherapy, DBT and IFS to name a few.

about.heading: The In Step Difference
about.description: Recognized for excellence in community mental health services, trauma-informed care, and innovative group therapy programs including our very own Stepping Stones & Parenting IQ developed by Cathi Cohen LCSW, CGP.
storyParagraphs: Founded with the vision of walking alongside individuals on their mental health journey, In Step has grown from a small practice to serving diverse populations with specialized care.
We specialize in offering a wide range of group treatments and individual services to children, adolescents, and adults including our renowned DBT Skills Groups and Stepping Stones social skills.

Our team takes special care to match individuals with appropriate support chronologically, developmentally, and emotionally, ensuring that every person receives the most effective and personalized care possible.

programs.heading: Therapy Programs
programs.description: Beyond traditional therapy, we offer specialized group programs designed to support individuals and families facing unique challenges and transitions.

items.title: DBT Skills Groups
items.description: Dialectical Behavior Therapy skills training in a supportive group environment, focusing on mindfulness, emotion regulation, and interpersonal effectiveness.

items.title: Stepping Stones TM (Youth)
items.description: Evidence-based social skills development for children ages 7-12 created by Cathi Cohen, LCSW, CGP. Cathi is Stepping Stones TM and Parenting IQ TM certified and trains our specialists.

items.title: Parenting IQ TM Program
items.description: Evidence-based parenting education and support created by Cathi Cohen, LCSW, CGP. Cathi is Parenting IQ TM and Stepping Stones TM certified and trains our parent coaches.

items.title: LEGO & Minecraft Therapy
items.description: Innovative social skills groups using LEGOs and Minecraft to teach collaboration, frustration tolerance, and problem-solving.

items.title: S.P.A.C.E. Treatment
items.description: Supportive Parenting for Anxious Childhood Emotions. A parent-based treatment program for children and teens with anxiety.

items.title: Women Psychotherapy Group
items.description: A supportive space for women to connect, share experiences, and grow together in a safe environment.

items.title: Neurodivergent Groups
items.description: Support, skills, and connection for neurodivergent individuals in a neuro-affirming environment.

items.title: Confidence/Social Groups
items.description: Building social confidence and connection through shared experiences and guided interaction.

testimonials.heading: Stories of Hope & Healing
testimonials.description: Hear from real people whose lives have been transformed through our programs and services. Your story of healing could be next.

items.name: Sarah M.
items.content: The DBT skills group at In Step changed my life. I learned how to manage my emotions and build healthier relationships. The group was so supportive and the facilitators were amazing.

items.name: Jennifer L.
items.content: Our family was struggling to communicate, but through family therapy at In Step, we learned to listen to each other and work through our problems together. We're stronger than ever now.

items.name: David K.
items.content: After years of struggling with anxiety and depression, I finally found the right therapist at In Step. The individual attention and evidence-based approach made all the difference.

items.name: James T.
items.content: The parenting program taught me how to set boundaries while showing love and support. My relationship with my teenager has improved dramatically. Highly recommend to any parent struggling.

items.name: Souhela P.
items.content: This program helped my son to gain his confidence back. And he tries to use [the lessons he learned] more in real life.

items.name: John and Melanie T.
items.content: My wife and I consulted with Cathi Cohen for several sessions when we were at a loss as to how to manage our daughter's behavior. We found her to be available and compassionate while also being a straight shooter. She helped us make some hard changes in our relationship that needed to happen.

members.name: Kimberley Grimes
members.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
members.bio:
Kimberley Grimes is a Licensed Clinical Social Worker specializing in individual, family, and group therapy for children, adolescents, and their families. She believes in the inherent strength of families and their capacity for growth, resilience, and healing. Kim helps clients develop effective coping skills, strengthen emotional and behavioral resilience, and build healthier, more connected relationships.

Kim earned her bachelor's degree in Child and Family Development from Virginia Tech and holds two master's degrees from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign in Social Work and Human and Community Development. Her experience spans foster care, medical settings, outpatient mental health clinics, and in-home therapy, giving her a well-rounded understanding of the challenges families face.

At In Step, Kim provides individual therapy for teens and adults, parenting support, and structured parent coaching. She also leads therapeutic social skills groups, including Stepping Stones Social IQ Development Groups, Parenting Groups, and Teen Interpersonal Groups—focused on emotional regulation, peer connection, and interpersonal effectiveness.

Kim also offers S.P.A.C.E. (Supportive Parenting for Anxious Childhood Emotions), an evidence-based, parent-based treatment developed by Dr. Eli Lebowitz to help families reduce accommodation and respond more effectively to a child's, teen's, or young adult's anxiety or OCD, including ARFID and challenges related to failure to launch. S.P.A.C.E. works directly with parents to reduce accommodation of anxiety, strengthen caregiver responses, and support lasting change across the family system. Parents gain practical, concrete strategies to build resilience and create a calmer, more confident home environment. This service is available in both individual and group formats. Watch Dr. Lebowitz's TEDx Talk to learn more: https://www.ted.com/talks/dr_eli_lebowitz_rethinking_treatment_for_child_anxiety_and_ocd

Kim partners closely with individuals and families to create personalized, strengths-based treatment plans that align with their values and support lasting change. Contact Kim to learn more about how she can support you and your family.
